meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 渲染动画视频并生成配音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做动画短视频，需要批量渲染并加配音。
copy.tagline_en: Render animated videos and generate voiceover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly make animated short videos and need batch rendering with voiceover.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行工具做视频开发：搭建项目、搜索动画组件、编写画面、检查质量、预览并在批准后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 HyperFrames 做视频动画、运行相关命令，或诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 初始化一个新项目。
say.note: 会运行 init 并创建项目骨架。

say.text: 在目录里搜索一个逐行揭示标题的动画。
say.note: 会调用 catalog 搜索现成动画。

say.text: 对当前项目运行最终检查并预览。
say.note: 会运行 check 并通过浏览器展示预览。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to develop videos: scaffolding projects, searching the animation catalog, authoring compositions, linting and checking quality, previewing, and rendering video files after approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit videos/animations with HyperFrames, run HyperFrames commands, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a new project with HyperFrames.
say_en.note: Runs init and scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for an animation that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Queries the local catalog for matching moves.

say_en.text: Run the final check on the current project and preview it.
say_en.note: Runs check and opens the browser preview.
